facts.value: This program consists of 4 courses, starting with a beginner course for students with no prior knowledge.
facts.programme_association: Master in Money, Macro and Finance

facts.value: The program includes levels A1 (Basic Chinese) and A2 (Business Chinese) according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages.
facts.programme_association: Master in Money, Macro and Finance

facts.value: After completing the entire program, students should achieve approximately the A1 level of the GER.
facts.programme_association: Master in Money, Macro and Finance

value.title: Basic Chinese Course 1
value.goal: To acquire basic vocabulary and strengthen knowledge of fundamental structures of the Chinese language.
value.assessment: Reading comprehension and writing competence will be tested in a 90-minute exam at the end of the semester, and a graded certificate will be awarded upon successful completion.
value.course_material: Information about the textbook will be provided in the first course meeting.
value.duration: GCH1 (13 double hours, including final exam)
value.semesters_offered: This course is offered only in the winter semester.

facts.programme_association: Master in Money, Macro and Finance

value.title: Basic Chinese Course 2
value.goal: To acquire basic vocabulary and strengthen knowledge of fundamental structures of the Chinese language.
value.assessment: Reading comprehension and writing competence will be tested in a 90-minute exam at the end of the semester, and a graded certificate will be awarded upon successful completion.
value.course_material: Information about the textbook will be provided in the first course meeting.
value.duration: GCH2 (13 double hours, including final exam)
value.semesters_offered: This course is offered only in the summer semester.

facts.programme_association: Master in Money, Macro and Finance

value.title: Business Chinese Course 1
value.prerequisites: Language skills based on HSK level I vocabulary lists are required; about 50 characters should be recognized passively.
value.goal: To develop business-related language skills with an emphasis on oral communicative competencies.
value.assessment: Language skills will be tested in a 90-minute exam at the end of the semester, and a graded certificate will be awarded upon successful completion.
value.course_material: Chinese Experience - Official Communication in China.
value.duration: WCH1 (13 double hours, including final exam)
value.semesters_offered: This course is offered only in the winter semester.

facts.programme_association: Master in Money, Macro and Finance

value.title: Business Chinese Course 2
value.prerequisites:
Language skills based on the vocabulary lists of the state-recognized language proficiency test HSK at levels I and II are required, and knowledge of characters at HSK level I.
Approximately 100 characters should be recognized passively.
value.goal: To further develop business-related language skills, emphasizing verbal communication competencies.
value.assessment: Language skills will be tested in a 90-minute exam at the end of the semester, and a graded certificate will be awarded upon successful completion.
units: At the official invitation (e.g., greeting, table talk, thanks)
value.course_material: Chinese Experience - Official Communication in China.
value.duration: WCH2 (13 double hours, including final exam)
value.semesters_offered: This course is offered only in the summer semester.
